description: Server-side exception - unhandled error in backend code

diagnostic_steps.step: Read exact file:line from stack trace
diagnostic_steps.command: Go directly to file and line number mentioned
diagnostic_steps.rationale: Stack trace tells you EXACTLY where to look

diagnostic_steps.command: Read the line, note what field/method is accessed
diagnostic_steps.rationale: AttributeError usually means missing field on model

diagnostic_steps.command: Read model definition, compare to repository/serializer expectations
Look for chained attribute access without null checks

common_bugs.cause: Repository or serializer expects field that doesn't exist on model
common_bugs.fix: Add field to model, makemigrations, migrate

common_bugs.cause: Model field type changed (CharField->UUIDField) but value object expects string
common_bugs.fix: Update value object: if isinstance(val, UUID): val = str(val)
Use try-except or hasattr() before access

common_bugs.cause: Optional field accessed without null check
common_bugs.fix: Add if field: guard before accessing
